claims: Monitor blood glucose levels closely given elevated levels.
Administer intravenous fluids to manage dehydration and electrolyte imbalances.
Continue insulin therapy for management of hyperglycemia.
Monitor respiratory parameters and adjust ventilator settings as necessary.
Assess and manage pain levels, if any, using appropriate analgesics.
Monitor INR and PT levels and adjust anticoagulation therapy as necessary.
Monitor kidney function with serum creatinine levels.
Continue monitoring for signs of pressure ulcers and provide appropriate care.
Administer prophylactic antibiotics if there is a risk of infection.
Discharge planning and ensure all necessary follow-up appointments are scheduled.
